title: An EmDash template provision freezes its installed token ruler and late polls cannot replace it
steps: Provide TEST_DATABASE_URL for an owned PostgreSQL test server. Run the host provision reader and web design-at-provision door tests.
Read the completed record through GET /api/sites/:key/design, then poll again with changed source data and try a different job or a later Build/Apply writer.
expect: Host stores the token snapshot before done; missing or oversized sources and an unreadable root leave the ruler unknown.
The rendered root selects dark values and fonts resolve from the installed font definitions. The token parser loads without workspace dependencies.
Only the original provision job can fill a null ruler. Repeated polls leave the first ruler unchanged; another job or Build/Apply writer is never overwritten and no absent record is invented.
fence: Snapshot before handover; atomic site/job/build ownership and null-token predicate.

tests: a fresh EmDash provision freezes its token sources before announcing done
imports and other CMS never read EmDash files
an unreadable, incomplete, oversized or timed-out snapshot leaves the ruler unknown
the container reader rejects oversized sources and never invents a root after a failed read
polling a completed EmDash provision fills its ruler once from the host snapshot
provision tokens yield to another build, job or look and never invent a record
the token parser works in the isolated web-image layout without a workspace dependency
